top_categories.workout_context: 651 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Race Across Benelux's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 651 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Race Across Benelux's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
At Race Across Benelux, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 651 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
651 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
39,042ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
60ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 39,042ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Race Across Benelux. Train it until it feels boring.
39,042ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Race Across Benelux, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.heat: May in Amsterdam to Arlon, plus an Arlon loop, via Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Race Across Benelux and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 651 miles requires a practiced resupply plan built around confirmed course services and available commercial stops. Rehearse frequent carbohydrate intake on long rides, then scale the plan to intensity, sleep strategy, tolerance, and real food across the full event. Carry redundant fuel and avoid applying a short-event hourly target or fixed total-calorie estimate to a multi-day race.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Race Across Benelux requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 651 miles of mixed terrain in Amsterdam to Arlon, plus an Arlon loop, via Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.
